items.title: Russia Reports 13 Dead After Ukrainian Drones Strike In Tatarstan
items.description: Russia said at least 13 people, including a child, were killed in Ukrainian attacks on targets in the central region of Tatarstan, one of Kyiv's deadliest single attacks since the Kremlin launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine more than four years ago.

items.title: Gaza mourns during 'largest collective funeral in Palestinian history'
items.description: The remains of 112 people belonging to the same family, killed by an Israeli strike on a residential building in the Palestinian enclave, were buried on August 4, two and a half years after their deaths. Palestinians lack the resources to search for and recover the thousands of bodies still trapped beneath the rubble.

items.title: ‘Sudan is losing another generation’ to war, Mohammed warns
items.description: More than 1,000 days of war in Sudan have left millions of children out of school, displaced or exposed to grave violations, the UN Deputy Secretary-General said on Friday, calling for renewed action to end the conflict.
